items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, и҃. ірмо́съ: Седмери́цею пе́щь, халде́йскій мучи́тель, бг҃очести́вымъ неи́стовнѡ разжжѐ, си́лою же лу́чшею, спасе́ны сїя̀ ви́дѣвъ, творцу̀ и изба́вителю вопія́ше: ѻ́троцы блгⷭ҇слови́те, свяще́нницы воспо́йте, лю́діе превозноси́те во вся̀ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The Chaldean tyrant furiously kindled the furnace sevenfold for the godly; but seeing them saved by a higher power, he cried aloud unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye youths, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supreme exalt Him unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Иди́же веселѧ́щихсѧ жили́ще, ны́нѣ всели́лсѧ єсѝ исповѣ́дниче, и и́стины побо́рниче, и свѣ́тъ тебѣ̀ возсїѧ̀, ꙗ́коже пра́ведникꙋ всемꙋ́дре, и му́ченикїя пострада́вшу по́двиги. съ ни́миже и взыва́еши: свяще́нницы благослови́те, лю́діе превозноси́те во вся̀ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: Where the dwelling of those who rejoice is, there hast thou now settled, O confessor and champion of the truth; and light hath dawned for thee, as for a righteous man, O all-wise one, who didst suffer the struggles of martyrs; with whom also thou criest aloud: Ye priests, bless; ye people, supreme exalt Him unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Терпѣ́нія вѣне́цъ прїя́лъ єсѝ бг҃опрїя́тне: во изгна́ніа бо гѡ́рькая всели́лся єсѝ, мзды̀ ѡжида́я воспрія́ти страда́ній твои́хъ, и бл҃гі́я не погрѣши́лъ єсѝ наде́жды, хрⷭ҇ту ны́нѣ взыва́я: свяще́нницы благослови́те, лю́діе превозноси́те во вся̀ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst receive the crown of endurance, O God-accepted one; for Thou didst settle in bitter exile,[^58] awaiting to receive the reward of thy sufferings; and Thou didst not miss thy good hope, crying now unto Christ: Ye priests, bless; ye people, supreme exalt Him unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣтоявле́ннѣ па́мять твоя̀, бг҃оно́се соверша́ется ны́нѣ, исповѣда́нія свѣ́томъ свѣтя́щися: ст҃ы́й бо ѡ́бразъ хрⷭ҇товъ поче́лъ єсѝ, и бцⷣы, и ст҃ы́хъ всѣ́хъ. съ ни́миже мнѣ̀ воспѣва́еши: свяще́нницы благослови́те, лю́діе превозноси́те во вся̀ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: Radiantly is thy memory celebrated now, O God-bearer, shining with the light of confession; for thou didst honor the holy image of Christ, and of the Birthgiver of God, and of all the saints; with whom thou dost sing: Ye priests, bless; ye people, supreme exalt Him unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вéчеръ на гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ, предварѧ́етъ самогла́сенъ днѐ, два̀, и мч҃ниченъ, и подо́бны трїѡ́ди, г҃. И ст҃ы́хъ мч҃никѡвъ на д҃. Стїхи́ры самогла́сны, Гла́съ в҃. Іѡа́нна мона́ха.
items.english_cohort_translation: Enduring present things valiantly, rejoicing in what is hoped for, the holy martyrs said one to another: It is not garments that we put off, but the old man we lay aside; severe is the winter, but sweet is paradise; painful is the ice, but sweet the reception; let us not turn aside, O soldiers, let us endure a little, that we may be crowned with victory wreaths from Christ God and the Savior of our souls! *(Twice)*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Имꙋ́ще ѡдѣя́ніа вся̀, вхожда́ху без тре́пета во є́зеро, дру́гъ ко дру́гу гла́ху, сті́и му́нцы: за ра́й, єго́же погуби́хомъ, ри́зъ тлѣ́нныхъ дне́сь не пощади́мъ, ѕмі́я ра́ди иногда̀ тлетво́рнагѡ ѡблече́ни бы́вше, совлече́мся ны́нѣ за всѣ́хъ воскрⷭ҇ніе, пренебре́жемъ ле́дъ растая́щійся, и пло́ть возненави́димъ: да вѣ́нцы побѣ́дными оувязе́мся, ѿ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, и сп҃са ду́шъ на́шихъ. Два́:
items.english_cohort_translation: Casting aside all garments, the holy martyrs entered into the lake without trembling, saying one to another: For the sake of the paradise which we lost, let us not spare corruptible garments today; having once been clothed because of the corrupting serpent, let us now strip ourselves for the resurrection of all; let us despise the melting ice, and hate the flesh, that we may be crowned with victory wreaths from Christ God and the Savior of our souls! *(Twice)*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Снѣда́юще ꙗ́кѡ наслажде́ніе му́ки, текꙋ́ще ко є́зеру сту́дену, ꙗ́кѡ къ теплотѣ̀, глаго́лаху сті́и мч҃еницы, не оустраши́мся часа̀ зи́мнагѡ, да стра́шнагѡ гее́нны ѻгня̀ оубѣжи́мъ: сожжена̀ бу́ди нога̀, да ликовствꙋ́етъ вѣ́чнѡ: рука̀ же ѿе́млема, да воздѣ́ется ко гдⷭ҇у. и не пощади́мъ єстества̀ оумира́ющагѡ, изво́лимъ сме́рть, да вѣ́нцы побѣ́дными оувязе́мся ѿ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, и сп҃са ду́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Devouring tortures as enjoyment, running unto the freezing lake as unto warmth, the holy martyrs said: Let us not fear the winter hour, that we may escape the dreadful fire of Gehenna! Let the foot be burned away, that it may dance eternally; let the hand be severed, that it may be lifted up unto the Lord! Let us not spare mortal nature, let us choose death, that we may be crowned with victory wreaths from Christ God and the Savior of our souls!

items.section: If the Presanctified Liturgy is not celebrated, we sing on the Aposticha the Idiomelon of the Triodion for the day, twice, and the Martyrikon.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ пѣснопѣ́ніихъ восхва́лимъ вѣ́рніи, страстоте́рпцевъ четы́редесятъ му́ченикѡвъ: и къ ни́мъ сладкопѣ́сненнѡ возопіи́мъ, глаго́люще: ра́дуйтеся страда́лцы хрⷭ҇товы, Иси́хїе, Мели́тѡне, Ира́клїе, Смара́где, и До́мне, Єѵні́ке, Оуа́ле, и Вівїа́не, Клавді́е, и При́ске. Ра́дуйтеся, Ѳео́доле, Єѵтѵ́хїе, и Іѡа́нне: Кса́нѳїе, Илїа́не, Сиси́нїе, Кѵрі́е, Аггі́е, Ае́тїе, и Фла́вїе. Ра́дуйтеся, Ака́кїе, Екди́кїе, Лѵсі́махе, Алеѯа́ндре, Илі́е, и Горго́нїе: Ѳео́філе, Дометіа́не и бж҃е́ственный Га́їе, и Горго́нїе. Ра́дуйтеся, Єѵтѵ́хїе, и Аѳана́сіе: Кѵ́рилле, и Сакердѡ́не: Нїкола́е, и Оуале́ріе, Фїлокти́ме, Северїа́не, и Хꙋ́діе. Ꙗ́кѡ имꙋ́щіи дерзнове́ніе ко хрⷭ҇ту бг҃у на́шему, му́ченицы всечестні́и: тогѡ̀ прилѣ́жнѡ моли́те, спасти́ся вѣ́рою соверша́ющымъ, всечестну́ю честну́ю па́мять ва́шу.
items.english_cohort_translation: In hymns let us, the faithful, praise the forty martyr passion-bearers, and sweet-voicedly cry aloud unto them, saying: Rejoice, O passion-bearers of Christ: Hesychius, Meliton, Heraclius, Smaragdus, and Domnus, Eunoicus, Valens, and Vivianus, Claudius, and Priscus! Rejoice, Theodulus, Eutychius, and John, Xanthius, Helianus, Sisinius, Cyrion, Angias, Aëtius, and Flavius! Rejoice, Acacius, Ecdicius, Lysimachus, Alexander, Elias, and Gorgonius, Theophilus, Dometian, and divine Gaius, and Gorgonius! Rejoice, Eutychus, and Athanasius, Cyril, and Sacerdon, Nicholas, and Valerius, Philoctemon, Severian, and Chudio![^64] As ye have boldness toward Christ our God, O all-honorable martyrs, fervently beseech Him that they may be saved who in faith celebrate your all-honorable memory!
items.slavonic_text: Въ пѣснопѣ́ніихъ восхва́лимъ вѣ́рніи, страстоте́рпцевъ четы́редесятъ му́ченикѡвъ: и къ ни́мъ сладкопѣ́сненнѡ возопіи́мъ, глаго́люще: ра́дуйтеся страда́лцы хрⷭ҇товы, Иси́хїе, Мели́тѡне, Ира́клїе, Смара́где, и До́мне, Єѵні́ке, Оуа́ле, и Вівїа́не, Клавді́е, и При́ске. Ра́дуйтеся, Ѳео́доле, Єѵтѵ́хїе, и Іѡа́нне: Кса́нѳїе, Илїа́не, Сиси́нїе, Кѵрі́е, Аггі́е, Ае́тїе, и Фла́вїе. Ра́дуйтеся, Ака́кїе, Екди́кїе, Лѵсі́махе, Алеѯа́ндре, Илі́е, и Горго́нїе: Ѳео́філе, Дометіа́не и бж҃е́ственный Га́їе, и Горго́нїе. Ра́дуйтеся, Єѵтѵ́хїе, и Аѳана́сіе: Кѵ́рилле, и Сакердѡ́не: Нїкола́е, и Оуале́ріе, Фїлокти́ме, Северїа́не, и Хꙋ́діе. Ꙗ́кѡ имꙋ́щіи дерзнове́ніе ко хрⷭ҇ту бг҃у на́шему, му́ченицы всечестні́и: тогѡ̀ прилѣ́жнѡ моли́те, спасти́ся вѣ́рою соверша́ющымъ, всечестну́ю честну́ю па́мять ва́шу.

Rejoice, Theodulus, Eutychius, and John, Xanthius, Helianus, Sisinius, Cyrion, Angias, Aëtius, and Flavius! Rejoice, Acacius, Ecdicius, Lysimachus, Alexander, Elias, and Gorgonius, Theophilus, Dometian, and divine Gaius, and Gorgonius! items.slavonic_diplomatic: Честну́ю тве́рдь церко́вную, ꙗ́кѡ ѕвѣ́зды велича́йшыя просвѣща́ете при́снѡ: и вѣ́рныя ѡзаря́ете, му́нцы бж҃твенніи хрⷭ҇товы четы́редесяте.
items.english_cohort_translation: As greatest stars ye ever enlighten the honorable firmament of the Church, and illuminate the faithful, O divine forty martyrs of Christ!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃ественнѣ́йшимъ по́мысломъ преше́дше муче́ніе, чу́дніи страстоте́рпцы. Сквозѣ̀ ѻ́гнь и во́ду проидо́сте, и преми... (Fol. 23v)
items.english_cohort_translation: With most divine purpose having traversed martyrdom, O marvelous passion-bearers, through fire and water ye passed, and ye pass and ye passed over into the broad expanse of salvation, receiving as an inheritance the heavenly kingdom, wherein make divine entreaties for us, O wise forty!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же благода́рнѡ воспѣва́ти ѿ се́рдца, и испроси́ти прилѣ́жнѡ бц҃е твоя̀ ми́лѡсти влⷣчце, рабы̀ твоя̀ зову́щыя и гл҃ющыя: прест҃ая дв҃о, предварѝ и изба́ви, ѿ вра́гъ неви́димыхъ и ви́димыхъ, и вся́кагѡ преще́нія: ты́ бо єсѝ на́ше заступле́ніе.
items.english_cohort_translation: Those who thankfully hymn thee from the heart and fervently ask thy mercies, O Birthgiver of God and Sovereign Lady, thy servants crying aloud and saying: O all-holy Virgin, forestall and deliver us from enemies invisible and visible, and from every threatening; for thou art our protection!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Къ кро́ву твоѝ пречтⷭ҇ая дв҃о прибѣга́ющихъ, мольбу̀ пріе́млющи ѿ на́съ, не преста́й моля́щи человѣколю́бца, спастѝ рабы̀ твоя̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Receiving the supplication from us who flee unto thy covering, O all-pure Virgin, cease not to pray unto the Lover of mankind that He save thy servants.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ст҃ы́хъ му́ченикъ оудобре́ніе, четверосвѣ́тлое сѐ и бг҃оизбра́нное, четы́редесяти мно́жество вѡ́инъ, вои́стинну: мра́зомъ же и ѻгне́мъ, иску́шшеся му́дріи, показа́шася во́инни всѣ́хъ цр҃я хрⷭ҇та̀, єго́же и моля́тъ, спасти́ся на́мъ. Два́жды:
items.english_cohort_translation: Behold the adornment of the holy martyrs, fourfold radiant and chosen by God, the multitude of forty soldiers in truth: tested by frost and fire, O wise ones, ye were shown forth as soldiers of Christ the King of all, Whom also they beseech that we may be saved. *(Twice)*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Себѐ пре́жде су́да ны́нѣ пла́чу, помышля́я моя̀ дѣла̀ лука́вая и лю́тая, и прегрѣше́ній глубину̀ совозра́стшую мнѣ̀ ѿ ю́ности чи́стая, и сподава́ющую оу́мъ: но твои́мъ предста́тельствомъ ѡставле́ніе мнѣ̀ пода́ждь, и сп҃ніе оулучи́ти сподо́би.
items.english_cohort_translation: I weep for myself before the judgment now, pondering my wicked and grievous deeds, and the depth of transgressions that grew up with me from my youth, O pure one, oppressing my mind; but by thy intercession grant me remission, and vouchsafe that I may attain salvation.

items.english_cohort_translation: Having rejected all earthly names, the forty chose the name of Christ, by which they now dwell in the highest.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Су́щїи во хрⷭ҇тѣ̀ пло́ть и мі́ръ возненави́дѣвше, ве́тхагѡ оу́бѡ чл҃ка совлако́шася, со привре́менною оде́ждею: во оде́жду же нетлѣ́нія ѡблеко́шася.
items.english_cohort_translation: Those who are in Christ, having hated the flesh and the world, put off the old man with temporal clothing, and clothed themselves in the garment of incorruption.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, ѝ. Подо́бенъ: Прему́дрости: Хрⷭ҇ту̀ сбо́рнившеся му́нчики, врага̀ низложи́вше страда́льчески: дѣ́лы испо́лнисте проро́ка глаго́лы, сквозѣ̀ бо ѻ́гнь и во́ду му́жески проидо́сте, поко́й ѡбрѣ́тше, жи́знь нетлѣ́нную. Тѣ́мже нб҃ными оукра́шшеся вѣнцы̀, съ ли́ки весели́теся безпло́тныхъ блаже́нніи, страстоте́рпцы прехва́льніи: моли́те, хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, грѣхѡ́въ ѡставле́ніе дарова́ти, чту́щымъ любо́вію ст҃ую па́мять ва́шу. Два́.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 8, Podoben: "Of Wisdom" (Премꙋ́дрости):* Having assembled as soldiers for Christ, O martyrs, having cast down the enemy through suffering, by your deeds ye fulfilled the sayings of the prophet; for through fire and water ye passed valiantly, finding rest, life incorruptible; therefore, adorned with heavenly crowns, ye rejoice with the choirs of the bodiless, O blessed, all-praised passion-bearers: beseech Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who honor your holy memory with love. *(Twice)*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ напа́сти многоплете́нныя впа́дъ, ѿ вра́гъ ви́димыхъ и неви́димыхъ: бу́рею ѡдержи́мь безчи́сленныхъ согрѣше́ній мои́хъ: и ꙗ́кѡ къ те́плому заступле́нію и покро́ву мо́ему чтⷭ҇ая, ко приста́нищу притека́ю твоея̀ бл҃гти. тѣ́мже пречтⷭ҇ая, из тебѐ воплоще́нному без сѣ́мене, моли́ся прилѣ́жнѡ ѡ всѣ́хъ рабѣ́хъ твои́хъ, непреста́ннѡ моля́щихтисѧ бцⷣе пречтⷭ҇ая. моля́щи єго̀ при́снѡ, согрѣше́ній ѡставле́ніе дарова́ти, воспѣва́ющымъ досто́йнѡ сла́ву твою̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having fallen into multifaceted trials from enemies visible and invisible, held fast by the tempest of my numberless sins, and fleeing unto thy warm protection and covering, O pure one, I take refuge in the haven of thy goodness; therefore, O all-pure one, fervently entreat Him Who was incarnate from thee without seed on behalf of all thy servants who unceasingly pray unto thee, O all-pure Birthgiver of God, entreating Him ever to grant remission of sins unto those who worthily hymn thy glory.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, гла́съ, ѕ҃. Подо́бенъ: Е́же ѡ҆ на́съ: Всѐ во́инство мі́ра ѡ҆ста́вльше, на нб҃сѣхъ вл҃цѣ прилѣпи́стеся, страстоте́рпцы гдⷭ҇ни четы́редесятъ: сквозѣ̀ ѻ́гнь бо и҆ во́дꙋ проше́дше блаже́ннїи, досто́йнѡ воспрїя́сте сла́вꙋ съ нб҃съ, и҆ вѣнце́въ мно́жество.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆́косъ: На прⷭ҇то́лѣ непристꙋ́пнѣмъ сѣдѧ́щемꙋ, просте́ршемꙋ нб҃о ꙗ҆́кѡ ко́жꙋ: и҆ зе́млю оу҆тверди́вшемꙋ, и҆ собра́вшемꙋ во́ды въ со́нмы и҆́хъ: всѧ̑ ѿ несꙋ́щихъ сотво́ршемꙋ бы́ти, и҆ всѣ̑мъ подаю́щꙋ дыха́нїе и҆ живо́тъ... живо́тъ: прїе́млющемꙋ ѿ а҆рха́гглъ пѣ́нїе, и҆ ѿ а҆́гглъ покланя́емомꙋ, и҆ ѿ всѣ́хъ сла́вимомꙋ, хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ вседержи́телю, зижди́телю и҆ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ: припа́даю недосто́йный, принося̀ моѐ моле́нїе, сло́ва благода́ти прошꙋ̀: да возмогꙋ̀ благоче́стнѡ воспѣ́ти и҆ а҆́зъ ст҃ы̑я, ꙗ҆́же са́мъ показа́въ побѣди́тели: дарова́въ и҆̀мъ сла́вꙋ съ нб҃съ, и҆ вѣнце́въ мно́жество.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:* Unto Him Who sits upon the unapproachable throne, Who stretched out the heaven as a skin, and established the earth, and gathered the waters into their gatherings; Who brought forth all things from non-existence into being, and gives breath and life unto all; and life; Who receives a hymn from the archangels, and is worshipped by angels, and glorified by all—unto Christ the Almighty, our Maker and God: I, the unworthy one, fall down, offering my supplication, and I ask for the word of grace, that I too may be able piously to hymn the holy ones whom He Himself showed forth as victors, granting them glory from the heavens and a multitude of crowns.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆жа́сна зря̀ вѣнцы̀ стра́жъ, четы́редесяти, и҆ шри́нꙋвъ любожи́зненное впери́ся раче́нїемъ ꙗ҆вле́нныя твоеѧ̀ сла́вы, и҆ съ мꙋ́ники поя́ше: благослове́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Seeing the terrifying crowns of the forty, the guard, having cast aside the love of earthly life, was borne aloft by longing for Thy manifest glory, and sang with the martyrs: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ ба́ню прите́къ дꙋшетлѣ́ннꙋю, оу҆мерщвля́ется жизнолю́бный: хрⷭ҇толю́бецъ же, хи́щникъ изря́днѣйшій ви́дѣнныхъ бы́въ: ꙗ҆́коже въ ба́ни нетлѣ́нїя, съ мꙋ́ченики поя́ше: благослове́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having run unto the soul-corrupting bath, he that loved earthly life was put to death; but the lover of Christ, having become an excellent plunderer of the things seen, as in a bath of incorruption sang with the martyrs: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Тѧ̀ кꙋпинꙋ̀ мѡѷсе́й, въ горѣ̀ сїна́йстѣй ѻ҆гнепла́мнꙋю чⷭ҇таѧ предзрѧ́ше: поне́сшꙋю неѡпа́льнѡ несте́рпимꙋю зарю̀, неизрече́ннагѡ сꙋщества̀: соедини́вшагѡся дебе́льствꙋ пло́ти, є҆ди́ныя въ не́й ст҃ы́хъ ѵ҆поста́сей.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Moses foresaw thee on Mount Sinai as the fiery burning bush, O pure one, which unburned bore the unendurable radiance of the ineffable Essence, Which united Itself to the grossness of the flesh, one of the holy Hypostases within it.[^76]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́нъ. і҆рмо́съ то́йже: Наста̀ свѣ́тлѡ лѣ́тная ва́ша па́мять всебога́тїи, просвѣща́ющи далечесїя́юща поста̀ свѣ́тлостїю: сїю̀ пра́зднꙋюще вѣ́рою, съ ва́ми воспѣва́емъ: благослове́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Brightly hath your yearly memory arrived, O all-rich ones, enlightening with the far-shining brightness of the Fast; celebrating it in faith, with you we sing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Рѣши́телїе страсте́й, и҆ свѣти́льницы и҆зда́леча сїя́ющїи, мі́ра ѡ҆чище́нїе, пре́лести разрꙋше́нїе, велегла́снїи и҆́стины проповѣ́дницы, лжѝ прогони́телїе, всѣ̑мъ ꙗ҆ви́стеся, пою́ще: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Loosers of passions, and luminaries shining from afar, purification of the world, destruction of delusion, loud-voiced preachers of truth, expellers of falsehood, ye have appeared unto all, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣти̑ла мы́сленная, сїя́юще на́мъ ꙗ҆ви́стеся мꙋ́нцы, ѡ҆бꙋрева́ємыѧ спаса́ете, и҆ наста́вляете пла́вающыя, житїѧ̀ волно́ю... волнꙋ́ющыяся бꙋ́рею, хрⷭ҇тꙋ во́спѣва́юще: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Spiritual luminaries, shining upon us have ye appeared, O martyrs; save those who are tempest-tossed, and guide those who sail upon the wave of life who are tossed by the storm, singing unto Christ: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кра́снѡ бг҃ꙋ, и҆ а҆́гглѡмъ вожделѣ́ннѡ, четы́редесѧте бг҃осо́бранное, и҆ бг҃одꙋхнове́нное, и҆ пресвѣ́тлое ѡ҆полче́нїе: бж҃твенное и҆ стра́шное всеорꙋ́жїе. вопїю́ще, и҆ глаго́люще: бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Beautiful unto God and desirable unto the angels is the God-gathered, God-inspired, and all-radiant army of the forty, a divine and terrifying panoply, crying aloud and saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thou wast shown forth as a luminary of the Light, and a radiant cloud, and a place of sanctification, O unwedded one; for thou didst receive the ineffable Word of the Holy of holies, singing unto Whom we cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Неми́лостивнѡ за хрⷭ҇та̀ тѣле́съ ва́шихъ оу҆́ды сокру́шшеся, всесожже́нїе бж҃е́ственно принесо́стеся бг҃ꙋ: со а҆́гглы при́снѡ ликꙋ́ете мꙋ́ченицы, пою́ще хрⷭ҇та̀ во вѣ́ки вся̑.
items.english_cohort_translation: When the limbs of your bodies were pitilessly crushed for Christ's sake, ye were offered as a divine whole burnt offering unto God; with the angels ye ever keep festival, O martyrs, singing unto Christ unto all ages.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Къ непреста́ннѣй жи́зни, правоте́чнѡ ѻ҆ сн҃е творѝ ше́ствїе, хрⷭ҇толюби́вая мт҃и, хрⷭ҇толюби́вомꙋ дѣ́тищꙋ вопїя́ше: не терплю̀ тебѐ второ́е, подвигополо́жникꙋ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ ꙗ҆ви́тися.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Unto unceasing life, make thy journey in a straight course, O my son!" cried the Christ-loving mother unto her Christ-loving child: "I cannot bear that thou shouldst appear second unto Christ the Umpire of the contest!"[^79]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́нъ. і҆рмо́съ то́йже: Оу҆свое́шася къ жи́зни и҆́стиннѣй, є҆́же ѡ҆ хрⷭ҇тѣ̀ ны́нѣ сокрове́ннѣй: къ зи́мней и҆ болѣ́зненнѣй кончи́нѣ, до́блїи крѣ́пкѡ вда́стеся, спасенїѧ и҆ ѡ҆ставле́нїя прося́ще на́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having made yourselves akin unto true life, which is now hidden in Christ, unto a cold and painful end ye gave yourselves up valiantly, O noble ones, asking salvation and remission for us.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Расто́ргъ сме́рти оу҆́зы сп҃съ, страда́льцемъ побѣ́ды подаде́ на сме́рть: четы́редесятъ бо мра́зомъ согрѣва́еми поя́хꙋ, и҆ спасенїя всѣ̑мъ вѣ́рнымъ... на́мъ прося́ще.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having broken the bonds of death, the Savior gave the passion-bearers victories over death; for warmed by the frost, the forty sang, asking salvation for all the faithful asking salvation for us.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. і҆рмо́съ: Ѿ бг҃а бг҃а сло́ва, неизрече́нною мꙋ́дростїю, прише́дшаго ѡ҆бнови́ти а҆да́ма, ꙗ҆́дїю въ тлѣ́нїе па́дшаго лю́тѣ: ѿ ст҃ы́я дв҃ы неизрече́ннѡ воплоти́вшагося на́съ ра́ди, вѣ́рнїи є҆диномꙋ́дреннѡ пѣ́снми велича́емъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: За хрⷭ҇та̀ ѡ҆бнажи́вшеся, и҆ ка́менїемъ бїе́ни бы́вше, воздꙋ́шнꙋю претерпѣ́сте зи́мность, во́дный ле́дъ, и҆ сокрꙋше́нїе оу҆де́съ, и҆ ѻ҆гне́мъ ѡ҆пали́стеся, въ рѣчне́й сїя́ете бы́стринѣ и҆зда́леча, ꙗ҆́коже свѣти̑ла мꙋ́нцы четы́редесяте.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having stripped yourselves for Christ, and having been struck with stones, ye endured the frost of the air, the ice of the water, and the crushing of your limbs, and were scorched with fire; and ye shine from afar in the swift currents of the river like luminaries, O forty martyrs![^80]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Же́злъ си́лы бж҃твенныя, крⷭ҇тъ стѧжа́вше, вопїѧ́хꙋ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ страда́лцы четы́редесѧте: вл҃ко всеси́льный побѣди́телю, рꙋко́ю твое́ю да вѣнча́емся, да всѝ тѧ̀ пѣ́сньми непреста́ннѡ велича́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having acquired the Cross as the rod of divine power, the forty passion-bearers cried aloud unto Christ: O Almighty Master and Victor, let us be crowned by Thy hand, that all of us may unceasingly magnify Thee in hymns!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ болѣ́зненъ оу҆́бѡ ле́дъ, ꙗ҆́коже ѕѣлѡ̀ безмѣ́рна лю́тость, ю҆́же претерпѣ́сте мра́за, но сла́докъ ра́й: а҆враа́мова бо нѣ́дра патрїа́рха грѣ́ютъ ва́съ, въ се́лѣхъ вѣ́чныхъ мꙋ́нцы четы́редесѧте.
items.english_cohort_translation: Though the ice was painful, and exceedingly immeasurable the severity of the frost which ye endured, yet sweet is paradise; for the bosom of the Patriarch Abraham warms you in eternal habitations, O forty martyrs!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Побѣди́вше страда́ньми и҆ вѣ́нцы прїи́мше, ѿ бж҃твенныя вл҃чни десни́цы, ны́нѣ дарова́ти моли́теся ми́ръ мі́рꙋ, побѣ́ды хрⷭ҇толюби́вомꙋ коро́лю, и҆ на́мъ спасенїе, мꙋ́нцы четы́редесѧте.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having conquered by sufferings and received crowns from the divine right hand of the Master, pray ye now that peace be granted unto the world, victories unto the Christ-loving King, and salvation unto us, O forty martyrs![^81]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Невѣ́сто м҃ти дв҃о, а҆́гглскаѧ мно́жества твоего̀ молѧ́тъ сн҃а, прїимѝ моле́нїе на́ше, є҆ди́на наде́жда бѣ́дныхъ: и҆ ми́ръ мі́рꙋ, побѣ́ды хрⷭ҇толюби́вомꙋ коро́лю, и҆ на́мъ спасенїе тебѣ̀ лю́бящымъ да́рꙋй.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* O Bride, Mother, Virgin, the angelic multitudes pray unto thy Son; receive our supplication, O only hope of the wretched, and grant peace unto the world, victories unto the Christ-loving King, and salvation unto us who love thee![^82]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́нъ. і҆рмо́съ то́йже: Преесте́ственнымъ зарѝ, и҆ ра́дости неска́занныя, и҆ сла́вы сподо́бистеся оу҆лꙋчи́ти: ны́нѣ же любо́вїю чтꙋ́щыѧ ва́съ, напа́стей и҆ бѣ́дъ, и҆ лꙋка́вствїа и҆зба́вите вра́жїа, хрⷭ҇товы во́инни, мꙋ́ченицы четы́редесѧте.
items.english_cohort_translation: Ye were vouchsafed to obtain supernatural radiance, ineffable joy, and glory; deliver now from tribulations, calamities, and enemy cunning those who honor you with love, O soldiers of Christ, forty martyrs!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Си́лꙋ пребога́тїи бж҃твеннꙋю съ нб҃се прїе́мше и҆ крѣ́пость, соꙋ́зницы хрⷭ҇товы: льстѝ прогони́телїе бы́сте, ѿгоня́ще всѧ́кꙋ і҆́дѡлскꙋю мгрꙋ̀ непостоя́ннꙋю, и҆ просвѣща́юще мі́ръ мꙋ́нцы четы́редесѧте.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having received divine power and strength from heaven, O companions of Christ, all-rich ones, ye became expellers of deception, driving away all unstable idol gloom, and enlightening the world, O forty martyrs!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆кра́шшеся добро́тою честна́гѡ мꙋче́нїя, и҆ бж҃е́ственнагѡ прича́стницы бы́вше є҆стества̀: вои́стиннꙋ ра́дꙋйтеся, свѣ́тꙋ сраствори́вшеся свѣтлѣ́йшемꙋ и҆ чⷭ҇томꙋ, хв҃ы во́инни, мꙋ́нцы четы́редесѧте.
items.english_cohort_translation: Adorned with the beauty of honorable martyrdom, and having become partakers of the divine nature: truly rejoice, having been commingled with the clearest and purest Light, O soldiers of Christ, forty martyrs!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ны́нѣ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ предстоя́ще благочести́вымъ дерзнове́нїемъ, и҆ ѿонꙋ́дꙋ бж҃ества свѣ́томъ ѡ҆блиста́еми сла́внїи, восхвалѧ́ющыѧ вы̀ заре́ю ѡ҆свѣти́тися трїсїя́нною, прилѣ́жнѡ моли́те мꙋ́нцы четы́редесѧте.
items.english_cohort_translation: Standing now before Christ with pious boldness, and illuminated thence with the light of the Godhead, O glorious ones: fervently pray, O forty martyrs, that they who praise you may be enlightened with the thrice-radiant dawn!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣти́ленъ. Подо́бенъ: Жены̀ оу҆слы́шите: Деся́тицꙋ четверочи́сленнꙋю, побѣдоно́сный по́лкъ, во́инство ст҃ы́хъ мꙋ́ченикъ воспои́мъ досто́йнѡ, ѻ҆гне́мъ бо и҆ стꙋде́нїю и҆ водо́ю, посрами́ша вражде́бныхъ полкѝ, и҆ ѿ хрⷭ҇та̀ сп҃са вѣнцы̀ прїя́ша сла́вы.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ли́къ четверодесяточи́сленный мꙋ́ченикѡвъ четы́редесяти, пребж҃твенныя трⷵцы, добро́дѣтелей четвери́чныхъ ѻ҆гня̀, возду́ха, воды̀, и҆ землѝ, стіхі́й четы́рехъ пѣ́сньми бж҃е́ственными да воспое́тся, ꙗ҆́кѡ за хрⷭ҇та̀ пострада́вшій всѣ́хъ вл҃кꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Let the company of the forty martyrs, fourfold in number, of the transcendent Trinity, fourfold in virtues, be hymned with divine songs of the four elements of fire, air, water, and earth, as having suffered for Christ the Master of all.[^84]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Па́кꙋбꙋ всеѧ̀ тва́ри ро́ждши м҃ти дв҃о, и҆ всѧ́ческихъ ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́щи ѻ҆трокови́ца: ѽ вл҃чце бцⷣе, страсте́й мꙋчи́тельствꙋющихъ мя̀ и҆схитѝ, и҆ проводѝ къ ма́рдїа ѡ҆сїя́нїю, и҆ къ прекра́сной пала́тѣ воскресшагѡ сн҃а твоегѡ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Mother and Virgin, who hast given birth unto the Deliverer from ruin for all creation,[^85] and as the Maiden who art over all things: O Sovereign Lady, Birthgiver of God, snatch me away from the passions that tyrannize over me, and lead me unto the radiance of emeralds,[^86] and unto the most fair bridal chamber of thy risen Son!

items.section: At the Praises, four Stichera, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прїиди́те мꙋ́ченическїи бра́тїе, съ похвала́ми воспои́мъ по́лкъ, мра́зомъ и҆ ѻ҆гне́мъ ѡ҆пали́вшійся, и҆ пре́лести зи́мꙋ разжже́нною ре́вностїю попали́вшій. во́инство добле́ственнѣйшее, сщ҃еннѣ́йшій собо́ръ, защище́нїе же неразрꙋши́мо и҆ непобѣди́мо: вѣ́ры забра́ла, и҆ храни́тели, мꙋ́ченикъ четы́редесѧти, ли́къ бж҃твенный, цр҃кве хода́тая, си́лнѣ молѧ́щыѧ хрⷭ҇та̀, низпосла́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ, ми́ръ и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость. Два́жды.
items.english_cohort_translation: Come, O brotherly company of martyrs, let us hymn with praises the regiment that was scorched by frost and fire, and that burned up the winter of delusion with kindled zeal: the most valiant army, the most sacred assembly, the indestructible and invincible rampart, the battlements and guardians of the faith, the divine choir of forty martyrs, the intercessors of the Church, who mightily pray unto Christ to send down peace and great mercy upon our souls! *(Twice)*

cohort_provenance.verbatim_source: Come, O brotherly company of martyrs, let us hymn with praises the regiment that was scorched by frost and fire, and that burned up the winter of delusion with kindled zeal: the most valiant army, the most sacred assembly, the indestructible and invincible rampart, the battlements and guardians of the faith, the divine choir of forty martyrs, the intercessors of the Church, who mightily pray unto Christ to send down peace and great mercy upon our souls! *(Twice)*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ра́дꙋйся собо́ре крѣ́пкїй и҆ терпѣли́вый, и҆ побѣди́тельное ѡ҆полче́нїе: столпы̀ бл҃гоче́стїя, во́инни хрⷭ҇товы, тверді́и ѻ҆рꙋ́жницы, и҆ непобѣди́мїи: оу҆мо́мъ преси́льнїи, и҆ дꙋше́ю мꙋ́жественнѣйшїи, вои́стиннꙋ... стиннꙋ бж҃твеннїи. бг҃ꙋ возжелѣ́нный ли́къ ст҃ы́й: бг҃оизбра́нный со́нмъ, мꙋ́нцы четы́редесѧте: и҆́же ра́вны страда́нїемъ, ра́вны и҆ нра́вомъ, и҆ ра́вныя и҆ вѣнцы̀ прїе́мше, хрⷭ҇та̀ моли́те: дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ми́ръ и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_cohort_translation: Rejoice, O steadfast and patient assembly, and victorious host, pillars of piety, soldiers of Christ, strong and invincible weapon-bearers, most mighty in mind and most courageous in soul, truly truly divine, the holy company beloved of God, the God-chosen host, the forty martyrs: who, equal in suffering and equal in mind, received equal crowns: entreat Christ to grant peace and great mercy unto our souls!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ра́дꙋйся побѣдоно́сное мно́жество, и҆́же на бра́нехъ до́блѣ мꙋ́жествовавше, ѕвѣ́зды проше́дше сквозѣ̀ ѻ́гнь и҆ стꙋ́день, и҆ во́дный ле́дъ разсы́павше: зе́млю ѡ҆небеси́вше, и҆ всѧ̑ просвѣти́вше: въ нѣ́дрѣхъ а҆враа́мовыхъ ны́нѣ грѣ́емїи, и҆ со а҆́гглскими ликꙋ́юще во́инствы, мꙋ́нцы четы́редесѧте: цвѣ́ты дыха́ющїи бл҃гово́нїе, сщ҃еннꙋ дꙋхо́внагѡ раздаѧ́нїа. хрⷭ҇та̀ моли́те, дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ дарова́ти ве́лїю мл҃ть.
items.english_cohort_translation: Rejoice, O victorious multitude, who fought valiantly in battles, stars passing through fire and cold, and shattering the water's ice; who made earth a heaven and enlightened all; who are now warmed in Abraham's bosom, and keep festival with the angelic hosts, O forty martyrs; flowers breathing forth the sweet fragrance of sacred spiritual distribution: entreat Christ to grant great mercy unto our souls!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Страстоте́рпцы хрⷭ҇товы, всечⷭ҇тны́й по́стъ свѣтлѣ́йшій содѣ́ласте, па́мятїю ва́шегѡ сла́внагѡ страда́нїя: четы́редесятъ бо сꙋ́ще, четы́редесѧ́тницꙋ ѡ҆сщ҃а́ете, спаси́тельнѣй стра́сти оу҆подо́бившеся, ва́шимъ за хрⷭ҇та̀ страда́нїемъ. тѣ́мже и҆мꙋ́ще дерзнове́нїе, моли́теся въ ми́рѣ дости́гнꙋти на́мъ, въ тридне́вное воскресе́нїе бг҃а и҆ сп҃са дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Passion-bearers of Christ, ye have made the all-honorable Fast most radiant by the memory of your glorious suffering; for being forty, ye sanctify the Forty Days, having been conformed unto the saving Passion by your suffering for Christ's sake; therefore, having boldness, pray ye that we may attain in peace unto the three-day Resurrection of God and the Savior of our souls!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бл҃жи́мъ тя̀ бцⷣе дв҃о, и҆ сла́вимъ тя̀ вѣ́рнїи по до́лгꙋ. гра́дъ непоколеби́мый, стѣ́нꙋ неѡбори́мꙋю, тве́рдꙋю предста́тельницꙋ, и҆ прибѣ́жище дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: We bless thee, O Virgin Birthgiver of God, and we the faithful glorify thee as is our duty: an unshakable city, an impregnable wall, a firm protectress, and the refuge of our souls.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆спи́вше ча́шею ѿ свои́хъ крове́й, ѻ҆гне́мъ мꙋче́нїй, и҆ во́днымъ ле́домъ вѣ́рныя напои́ша: четверочи́сленная бо десяти́ца пою́щи пѣ́снь сп҃сꙋ, є҆ди́нъ оу҆́бѡ оу҆́мъ всѣ̑мъ, въ тѣлесѣ́хъ же мно́зѣхъ принесо́шася хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀. и҆ бг҃онѣвѣ́стнаѧ мт҃и, хрⷭ҇толюби́ваго ѻ҆́трока на ра́мена взе́мши, глаго́лаше: грядѝ страда́лче, и҆ постражѝ съ про́чими.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having drunk from the chalice of their own blood, by the fire of tortures and the ice of water they gave drink unto the faithful; for the fourfold decade, singing a hymn unto the Savior, had one mind among all, though in many bodies they were offered unto Christ; and the God-espoused mother, taking the Christ-loving youth upon her shoulders, said: "Go, O sufferer, and suffer with the rest!"[^88]
items.slavonic_text: И҆спи́вше ча́шею ѿ свои́хъ крове́й, ѻ҆гне́мъ мꙋче́нїй, и҆ во́днымъ ле́домъ вѣ́рныя напои́ша: четверочи́сленная бо десяти́ца пою́щи пѣ́снь сп҃сꙋ, є҆ди́нъ оу҆́бѡ оу҆́мъ всѣ̑мъ, въ тѣлесѣ́хъ же мно́зѣхъ принесо́шася хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀. и҆ бг҃онѣвѣ́стнаѧ мт҃и, хрⷭ҇толюби́ваго ѻ҆́трока на ра́мена взе́мши, глаго́лаше: грядѝ страда́лче, и҆ постражѝ съ про́чими.
items.english_text: Having drunk from the chalice of their own blood, by the fire of tortures and the ice of water they gave drink unto the faithful; for the fourfold decade, singing a hymn unto the Savior, had one mind among all, though in many bodies they were offered unto Christ; and the God-espoused mother, taking the Christ-loving youth upon her shoulders, said: "Go, O sufferer, and suffer with the rest!"[^88]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Е҆́зеро ꙗ҆́кѡ ра́й, и҆ зи́мность ꙗ҆́кѡ зно́й, мꙋ́нцы вмѣни́ша хрⷭ҇тѐ бж҃е, не оу҆страши́ша по́мыслы и҆́хъ, томи́телей преще́нїя, не оу҆боя́шася до́блїи мꙋ́къ приложенїй, ѻ҆рꙋжено́сный стѧжа́вше крⷭ҇тъ: тѣ́мъ бо врага̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ крѣ́пцыи побѣди́ша. тѣ́мже и҆ вѣнцы̀ прїя́ша благода́ти.
items.english_cohort_translation: The lake as paradise, and the cold as heat did the martyrs reckon, O Christ God; the threats of the tyrants did not terrify their thoughts; the valiant ones did not fear the afflictions of torments, having acquired the weapon-bearing Cross; for thereby they conquered the enemy as mighty ones; therefore also they received crowns of grace.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Четверодесяточи́сленный ли́къ мꙋ́ченнкъ, кто̀ не воспое́тъ? въ во́дꙋ бо є҆́зера внидо́ша де́рзостнѣ, и҆ мра́зомъ стѧза́еми, пѣ́снь воспѣва́хꙋ гдⷭ҇ꙋ: є҆да̀ въ рѣ́кахъ прогнѣ́ваешися на ны̀ гдⷭ҇и? є҆да̀ въ рѣка́хъ прогнѣ́вавшися на ны̀ человѣколю́бче? ѡ҆блегчѝ тя́жесть, и҆ го́ресть воздꙋ́ха: свое́ю бо кро́вїю ѡ҆багри́шася на́ши но́ги, и҆ введи́ ны бж҃е въ вѣ́чныѧ твоѧ̑ кро́вы: да нѣ́дро ны согрѣ́етъ, патрїа́рха а҆враа́ма.
items.english_cohort_translation: The choir of the forty martyrs, who will not hymn? For they entered into the water of the lake boldly, and contending with the frost, they sang a hymn unto the Lord: "Art Thou angry with us in the rivers, O Lord? Art Thou angry with us in the rivers, O Lover of mankind?[^89] Lighten the weight and the bitterness of the air, for our feet are stained with our own blood; and lead us, O God, into Thine eternal tabernacles, that the bosom of the Patriarch Abraham may warm us!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Проро́чески оу҆́бѡ вопїя́ше дв҃дъ во ѱалмѣ́хъ: проидо́хомъ сквозѣ̀ ѻ́гнь и҆ во́дꙋ, и҆ и҆зве́лъ ны̀ є҆сѝ въ поко́й. Вы́ же мꙋ́нцы хрⷭ҇товы, самѣ́ми дѣ́лы сло́во и҆сполня́ющи, проидо́сте сквозѣ̀ ѻ́гнь и҆ во́дꙋ, и҆ внидо́сте въ црⷭ҇тво нб҃сное. тѣ́мже моли́теся четы́редесятъ сщ҃е страда́лцы, дарова́ти на́мъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_cohort_translation: David prophetically cried aloud in the Psalms: "We went through fire and water, and Thou leddest us out into refreshment."[^90] But ye, O martyrs of Christ, fulfilling the word by deeds themselves, passed through fire and water, and entered into the heavenly kingdom; therefore pray, ye forty sacred passion-bearers, that great mercy may be granted unto us!

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: And the rest of the Divine Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Matins, at "God is the Lord," the Troparion of the Martyrs twice; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion: "All things beyond comprehension." After the first Kathisma, both Sessional Hymns of the Martyrs; Glory... Both now... Theotokion; and reading of the Martyrs. After the second Kathisma, the Sessional Hymn of Theodore; Glory... Both now... Theotokion; and reading of the Martyrs, or of Theodore. Polyeleos, and Sessional Hymn of the Martyrs twice; Glory... Both now... Theotokion; and reading of the Martyrs. Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi], the first Antiphon of Tone 4. Prokeimenon, and "Let every breath," and the Gospel of the Martyrs. Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Martyrs. Canons of the Martyrs with the Heirmos to 6, and for Theodore both Canons to 8; Katavasia: "I will open my mouth"; Odes 7 and 8 we said beforehand on Friday.*

internal_coordinates.podoben_label_raw: After Ode 3, the Kontakion, and Ikos, and Sessional Hymn of the Martyrs; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion; and reading concerning St. Theodore. After Ode 6, the Kontakion of Theodore, and Ikos; and we read the Prologue and Synaxarion. After Ode 9, the Exapostilarion of the Martyrs; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion. At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs 3, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ); and for Theodore, Prosomoia 3. Then the Refrain: "We went through fire and water"; and we sing the Idiomelon Sticheron of the Martyrs: "Trophy-bearers of Christ"; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion. Great Doxology. Troparion of the Martyrs; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion. Litanies, and the Dismissal, and the usual procession into the narthex, and the First Hour. At the Hours, the Troparion of the Martyrs; Glory of Theodore; Both now... the Theotokion of the Hours; and we say the Kontakia alternating. At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Martyrs, Ode 3 on 4; and of Theodore, Ode 6 on 4. After the Entrance, the Troparion of the Martyrs, and of Theodore, and his Kontakion; Glory of the Martyrs; Both now... of the Theotokos of the temple, or: "O Protection of Christians"; Prokeimenon, Alleluia, and Communion Verse of the Martyrs and of Theodore; the Epistle and Gospel first of Saturday, and of Theodore according to pericope, then of the Martyrs.

items.section: At Matins, at "God is the Lord," the Troparion of the Martyrs twice; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion: "All things beyond comprehension." After the first Kathisma, both Sessional Hymns of the Martyrs; Glory... Both now... Theotokion; and reading of the Martyrs. After the second Kathisma, the Sessional Hymn of Theodore; Glory... Both now... Theotokion; and reading of the Martyrs, or of Theodore. Polyeleos, and Sessional Hymn of the Martyrs twice; Glory... Both now... Theotokion; and reading of the Martyrs. Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi], the first Antiphon of Tone 4. Prokeimenon, and "Let every breath," and the Gospel of the Martyrs. Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Martyrs. Canons of the Martyrs with the Heirmos to 6, and for Theodore both Canons to 8; Katavasia: "I will open my mouth"; Odes 7 and 8 we said beforehand on Friday.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: По г҃ пѣ́сни конда́къ, и҆ і҆́косъ, и҆ сѣда́ленъ мꙋ́никѡвъ: сла́ва ѳео́дѡра, и҆ ны́нѣ бг҃оро́диченъ: и҆ чте́нїе ѡ҆ ст҃е́мъ ѳео́дѡрѣ. По ѕ҃ пѣ́сни, конда́къ ѳео́дѡра, и҆ і҆́косъ: и҆ чте́мъ про́логъ и҆ сѷнаѯа́рїй. По ѳ҃ пѣ́сни, свѣти́ленъ мꙋ́никѡвъ: сла́ва ѳео́дѡра, и҆ ны́нѣ бгоро́диченъ. На хвали́техъ стїхи̑ры мꙋ́ченикѡвъ, г҃. гла́съ є҃: подо́бенъ: Ра́дꙋйся: и҆ ѳео́дѡра, подо́бн: г҃: Та́же припѣ́въ: Проидо́хомъ сквозѣ̀ ѻ́гнь и҆ во́дꙋ: и҆ пое́мъ самогла́снꙋ стїхи́рꙋ мꙋ́никѡвъ: Стратоно́сцы хрⷭ҇товы: сла́ва, ѳео́дѡра, и҆ ны́нѣ, бгоро́диченъ. Славосло́вїе вели́кое: тропа́рь мꙋ́ченникѡвъ: сла́ва, ѳео́дѡра, и҆ ннѣ̀, бгоро́диченъ. є҆ктенїѝ, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. и҆ ѻ҆бы́чное и҆схожде́нїе въ притво́ръ: и҆ ча́съ а҃-й. На часѣ́хъ тропа́рь мꙋ́никѡвъ: сла́ва ѳео́дѡра, и҆ ны́нѣ бгоро́диченъ часѡ́въ: кондаки́ же глаго́лемъ премѣня́юще. На лїтꙋргі́и блаже́нна мꙋ́никѡвъ, пѣ́снь г҃, на д҃: и҆ ѳео́дѡра ѕ҃-я, на д҃. По вхо́дѣ тропа́рь мꙋ́ченникѡвъ, и҆ ѳео́дѡра, и҆ конда́къ є҆гѡ̀: сла́ва мꙋ́ченникѡвъ: и҆ ны́нѣ бцⷣы хра́ма, и҆лѝ, предста́тельство хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ: Прокі́менъ, а҆λληлꙋ́їа, и҆ прича́стенъ: мꙋ́никѡвъ, и҆ ѳео́дѡра: а҆́пⷭ҇лъ и҆ є҆ѵ҃лїе пре́жде, сꙋббѡ́ты: и҆ ѳео́дѡра по зача́ло: та́же мꙋ́никѡвъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: After Ode 3, the Kontakion, and Ikos, and Sessional Hymn of the Martyrs; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion; and reading concerning St. Theodore. After Ode 6, the Kontakion of Theodore, and Ikos; and we read the Prologue and Synaxarion. After Ode 9, the Exapostilarion of the Martyrs; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion. At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs 3, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ); and for Theodore, Prosomoia 3. Then the Refrain: "We went through fire and water"; and we sing the Idiomelon Sticheron of the Martyrs: "Trophy-bearers of Christ"; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion. Great Doxology. Troparion of the Martyrs; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion. Litanies, and the Dismissal, and the usual procession into the narthex, and the First Hour. At the Hours, the Troparion of the Martyrs; Glory of Theodore; Both now... the Theotokion of the Hours; and we say the Kontakia alternating. At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Martyrs, Ode 3 on 4; and of Theodore, Ode 6 on 4. After the Entrance, the Troparion of the Martyrs, and of Theodore, and his Kontakion; Glory of the Martyrs; Both now... of the Theotokos of the temple, or: "O Protection of Christians"; Prokeimenon, Alleluia, and Communion Verse of the Martyrs and of Theodore; the Epistle and Gospel first of Saturday, and of Theodore according to pericope, then of the Martyrs.

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: And the rest of the Divine Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha of the day from the Triodion. After "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart," and after "Our Father,"*
items.office: And the rest of the Divine Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts
items.section: At the Aposticha of the day from the Triodion. After "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart," and after "Our Father,"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тропа́рь: Бцⷣе дѣ́во ра́дꙋйсѧ: И҆ про́чее по по́стномꙋ. По чтнѣ́йшꙋю, и҆ по покло́нѣхъ глаго́лемъ трⷭ҇то́е. гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй, в҃і. Всест҃а́ѧ трⷪ҇це: Та́же, бꙋ́ди и҆́мѧ гдⷭ҇не. и҆ г҃ покло́ны: И҆ бл҃гвлю̀ гдⷭ҇а: Досто́йно є҆́сть. И҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. На ѿпꙋ́стѣ же помина́етъ наста́вшаго ст҃а́го. По ѿпꙋ́стѣ же вхо́димъ въ трапе́зꙋ, ꙗ҆ди́мъ два̀ варе́нїа с̾ є҆ле́емъ, и҆ пїе́мъ вїно̀. Въ средꙋ́ же и҆ пѧто́къ, ꙗ҆ди́мъ два̀ варе́нїа бѐз̾ є҆́леа, и҆ пїе́мъ вїно̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion: "O Birthgiver of God and Virgin, rejoice!" and the rest according to the Lenten order. After "More honorable than the Cherubim," and after the prostrations, we say the Trisagion; "Lord, have mercy," 12 times; "All-Holy Trinity"; then: "Blessed be the name of the Lord," and 3 prostrations; and "I will bless the Lord at all times";*[^104] *"It is truly meet"; and the Dismissal. At the Dismissal, the priest commemorates the Saint of the incoming day. After the Dismissal, we enter the trapeza, and we eat two cooked dishes with oil, and we drink wine. On Wednesday and Friday, we eat two cooked dishes without oil, and we drink wine.*

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Month of March ...with a Kathisma, as was prescribed for Monday of the 2nd week of the Fast. Likewise also Matins, and the entire service of the Martyrs
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera, Tone 1:*
items.office: Month of March ...with a Kathisma, as was prescribed for Monday of the 2nd week of the Fast. Likewise also Matins, and the entire service of the Martyrs

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Съ прехва́лнымъ кодра́томъ, * да воспое́тсѧ свѣ́тлѡ * кѵпрїа́нъ вели́кїй, дїонѵ́сїа два̀, * и҆ а҆не́ктъ досто́йнѡ, * кри́скъ вкꙋ́пѣ, * и҆ сла́вный па́ѵелъ вѣ́рнѡ: * ꙗ҆́кѡ страда́льцы гдⷭ҇ни бг҃овѣнча́нны, * и҆ моли́твенницы на́ши тепле́йшіи.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сщ҃еннопобѣ́дныхъ мꙋ́ченниковъ, * и҆ побѣдоно́сныхъ * ли́къ дне́сь дрꙋгі́й ꙗ҆ви́сѧ, * ѡ҆зарѧ́ющь собо́ръ бж҃твенныхъ страстоте́рпецъ: тве́рдое число̀, * и҆збра́нное ко́нньство: * є҆мꙋ́же нача́льствꙋетъ кодра́тъ, бл҃госла́вный побѣди́тель проѧвлѧ́ѧ, * и҆ вкꙋ́пѣ со страстоте́рпцы вѣнча́емь.
items.english_cohort_translation: Another choir of sacredly victorious and triumphant martyrs hath appeared today, illuminating the assembly of the divine passion-bearers: a steadfast number, a chosen company, over which Codratus is commander, shown forth as a glorious victor, and crowned together with the passion-bearers.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Рито́рскїѧ оу҆́бѡ мꙋ́дрости * многоплета́ннаѧ плете́нїа, * сѣчи́тельнымъ твои́мъ сло́вомъ * разори́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ мглꙋ̀, * прехва́лный кодра́те: * навꙋчи́вши вѣ́рнѡ, * и҆ страда́вши терпѣли́внѡ за хрⷭ҇та̀. бо ѻ҆бои́хъ бл҃гоꙋкраша́ѧсѧ, * и҆ вкꙋ́пѣ со страстоте́рпцы вѣнча́емь.
items.english_cohort_translation: The intricate entanglements of rhetorical wisdom hast thou destroyed like mist by thy cutting word, O all-praised Codratus; having faithfully taught, and patiently suffered for Christ, adorned with both, and crowned together with the passion-bearers.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆держи́мы погрешѣ́нїи ненаде́жными чтⷭ҇аѧ, тѧ̀ предста́тельницꙋ є҆ди́нꙋ стѧжа́вше дв҃о, вопїе́мъ благода́рственнѡ: ѡ҆чи́сти ны ѻ҆ртла̀ бг҃оневѣ́сто: ты́ бо є҆сѝ мі́ра прибѣ́жище, и҆ застꙋпле́нїе ро́да на́шегѡ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Held fast by hopeless transgressions, O pure one, having acquired thee as our sole intercessor, O Virgin, we cry aloud in thanksgiving: Purge us from defilements, O Bride of God; for thou art the refuge of the world, and the protection of our race.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вознесе́на ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ а҆́гнца, непоро́чнаѧ дв҃а, пла́чꙋщи вопїѧ́ше: Сла́дкое моѐ ча́до, что̀ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное видѣ́нїе? ка́кѡ содержа́й всѧ́ческаѧ горе́стїю, на дре́вѣ пригвожда́ешисѧ пло́тїю.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion, the same Podoben (Подо́бенъ то́йже):* When the blameless Virgin beheld the Lamb lifted up upon the Cross, weeping she cried aloud: O my sweet Child, what is this new and most glorious sight? How dost Thou Who holdest all things in Thy hand hang in bitterness, nailed in the flesh unto the Tree?

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ сл҃нце свѣ́тлое, добродѣ́телей свѣтоно́сїемъ возсїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ на́мъ, кодра́те страда́льче, свѣтолꙋ́чными твои́ми сїѧ́нїи, тмꙋ̀ многобо́жїа ѿгонѧ̀ бл҃же́нне, и҆ просвѣща́ѧ вѣ́рныхъ соста́влєнїа.
items.english_cohort_translation: Like a radiant sun, by the light-bearing dawn of virtues, hast thou shone forth upon us, O passion-bearer Codratus, by thy light-beaming rays driving away the darkness of polytheism, O blessed one, and enlightening the assemblies of the faithful.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ка́мень жи́зни і҆и҃са сп҃са возвѣщ́ающе бг҃а, пострада́сте тве́рдѡ: и҆сто́чникъ спасенїѧ, ка́мень прїе́мшїи, крове́й тече́нїа содѣ́ласте мꙋ́ченицы сла́вніи.
items.english_cohort_translation: Proclaiming Jesus the Savior and God as the Rock of life, ye suffered steadfastly; and having received a stone as a fountain of salvation, ye made streams of blood gush forth, O glorious martyrs.[^118]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ѡ҆тиме́нїа страсте́й, помышле́нїй требова́нїѧ, ѿ стрѣ́лъ вра́жїихъ, ѿ всѧ́кагѡ прило́га сопроти́вна спасѝ, чт҃аѧ бг҃ородительнице, дꙋ́шы пою́щихъ твоѐ несказа́нное ржⷭ҇тво всенепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* From the assault of passions, from the demand of sinful thoughts, from the arrows of the enemy, and from every contrary assault, save, O pure Birthgiver of God, the souls of them that hymn thine ineffable childbirth, O all-blameless one.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ниже́ є҆ди́ный оу҆́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ ржⷭ҇тва̀ твоегѡ̀, мо́жетъ сказа́ти ѻ҆трокови́це: оу҆́мъ бо пе́рвагѡ во оу҆тро́бѣ, сло́во чтⷭ҇аѧ зачала̀ є҆сѝ, всѧ́ческаѧ сло́вомъ соста́вльшаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Not even a single mind can declare the mystery of thy childbirth which surpasses the mind, O Maiden; for in thy womb, O pure one, thou didst conceive the Word of the First Mind, Who established all things by His Word.

items.section: Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross" (Вознесы́йсѧ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Вознесы́йсѧ: Терпѣ́нїемъ лю́тыхъ, оу҆мертви́лъ є҆сѝ го́рдаго врага̀ страстоте́рпче, мечно́ю сме́рть претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, вкꙋ́пѣ со страждꙋ́щими съ тобо́ю всемꙋ́дрыми кодра́те. тѣ́мже пра́зднꙋемъ честнꙋ́ю ва́шꙋ па́мѧть, вопїю́ще: помѧни́те на́съ ко влⷣцѣ непобѣди́мїи мꙋ́ченицы.
items.english_cohort_translation: By the endurance of cruel torments, thou didst slay the proud enemy, O passion-bearer, having endured death by the sword together with the all-wise who suffered with thee, O Codratus; therefore do we celebrate your precious memory, crying aloud: Remember us before the Master, O unconquerable martyrs!

Подо́бенъ: Вознесы́йсѧ:
Терпѣ́нїемъ лю́тыхъ, оу҆мертви́лъ є҆сѝ го́рдаго врага̀ страстоте́рпче, мечно́ю сме́рть претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, вкꙋ́пѣ со страждꙋ́щими съ тобо́ю всемꙋ́дрыми кодра́те. тѣ́мже пра́зднꙋемъ честнꙋ́ю ва́шꙋ па́мѧть, вопїю́ще: помѧни́те на́съ ко влⷣцѣ непобѣди́мїи мꙋ́ченицы.

cohort_provenance.verbatim_source: By the endurance of cruel torments, thou didst slay the proud enemy, O passion-bearer, having endured death by the sword together with the all-wise who suffered with thee, O Codratus; therefore do we celebrate your precious memory, crying aloud: Remember us before the Master, O unconquerable martyrs!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крⷭ҇тобгоро́диченъ: И҆́же ѿ безна́чалнагѡ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ рожде́ннаго, напослѣ́докъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю ро́ждшаѧ, на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ ви́сѧща зрѧ́щи хрⷭ҇тѐ, оу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ любе́знѣйшїй і҆и҃се вопїѧ́ше: ка́кѡ сла́вимый ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ ѿ а҆́гглъ, ѿ беззако́нныхъ ны́нѣ человѣ́къ сн҃е хотѧ̀ распина́ешисѧ: пою́ тѧ долготерпѣли́ве.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion:* She who in the latter days gave birth in the flesh unto Him Who was begotten of the unoriginate Father, beholding Thee hanging upon the Cross, O Christ, cried aloud: Woe is me, O most beloved Jesus! How art Thou Who art glorified as God by the angels now willingly crucified by lawless men, O Son? I hymn Thee, O longsuffering One!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́дростїю твои́хъ слове́съ, немꙋ́дрыѧ посрами́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ наказа́нїемъ бг҃ови́дныхъ оу҆че́нїй твои́хъ, мч҃нче кодра́те оу҆лови́лъ є҆сѝ, бж҃е́ственнаго а҆ні́кта: влⷣцѣ твое́мꙋ приво́диши, терпѣли́ва мꙋ́ченика.
items.english_cohort_translation: By the wisdom of thy words, thou didst put the foolish to shame, and by the instruction of thy God-beholding teachings, O martyr Codratus, thou didst catch divine Anectus; unto thy Master dost thou lead him, a patient martyr.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Гное́нїа ва́ша мꙋ́чеческаѧ, и҆спꙋща́ютъ бл҃гово́нїе по́лно бл҃года́ти: кро́ви сꙋ́хъ, цѣле́бъ и҆злива́ютъ то́ки бж҃твеннымъ дх҃омъ, и҆ стра́сти дꙋшеталѣ́нныѧ и҆сцѣлѧ́ютъ: ꙗ҆́же досто́йнѡ оу҆блажи́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Your martyrly wounds pour forth a fragrance full of grace; streams of dried blood pour forth torrents of healing by the Divine Spirit, and cure soul-corrupting passions; therefore let us worthily call them blessed.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кра́сенъ ꙗ҆́звъ добро́тами бы́въ, а҆́гг҃лѡмъ оу҆подо́билсѧ є҆сѝ: кро́вїю же и҆злїѧ́нною кодра́те всѣ́дъ ꙗ҆́кѡ на колесни́цꙋ, возлетѣ́лъ є҆сѝ къ бы́вшымъ црⷭ҇твѡмъ, по́чести болѣ́зней прїе́млѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Made comely by the beauty of wounds, thou wast assimilated unto the angels; and mounting the shed blood as upon a chariot, O Codratus, thou didst fly up unto the eternal kingdoms, receiving the rewards of thy sufferings.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆сточа́ѧ бж҃е́ственную сла́дость и҆зъ оу҆́стъ, страда́льческїй собо́ръ оу҆бѣща́лъ є҆сѝ, мꙋ́чениче кодра́те страдати съ тобо́ю, а҆не́кта и҆ па́ѵла, и҆ крїске́нта: кѵпрїа́на же и҆ бж҃твеннаго дїонѵ́сїа: съ ни́миже ликꙋ́еши досточꙋ́дне.
items.english_cohort_translation: Pouring forth divine sweetness from thy mouth, O martyr Codratus, thou didst persuade the assembly of sufferers to suffer with thee: Anectus, and Paul, and Crescent, Cyprian, and divine Dionysius, with whom thou exultest, O worthy of marvel.

Ꙗ҆́вльшисѧ всѣ́хъ, тво́рца роди́тельница, па́че всѧ́кагѡ оу҆ма̀ всенепоро́чнаѧ, небе́съ вы́шши показа́ласѧ є҆сѝ, и҆ всѣ́ми влады́чествꙋющи, дв҃о бг҃ороди́тельнице нескве́рнаѧ: тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ всѝ непреста́ннѡ велича́емъ.

cohort_provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Having appeared as the Birthgiver of the Creator of all beyond every mind, O all-immaculate one, thou hast been revealed as higher than the heavens, and queen over all, O pure Virgin Mother of God; therefore we all unceasingly magnify thee.

items.english_cohort_translation: Being named after chaste wisdom,[^128] called Sophronius by divine foreknowledge, thou wast chaste in deeds, righteous, courageous, and prudent, valiantly crowned with the kindred virtues; and thou didst abide flourishing in both soul and body, like an excellent steward.

items.english_text: Being named after chaste wisdom,[^128] called Sophronius by divine foreknowledge, thou wast chaste in deeds, righteous, courageous, and prudent, valiantly crowned with the kindred virtues; and thou didst abide flourishing in both soul and body, like an excellent steward.

slavonic_provenance.verbatim_source:
Цѣломꙋ́дрїа тезоимени́тъ, * ѿ бж҃е́ственнагѡ проразꙋмѣ́нїа, прозва́нъ бы́въ сѡфро́нїе. * цѣломꙋ́дръ бы́лъ є҆сѝ въ дѣ́лѣхъ, и҆ пра́веденъ, мꙋ́жественъ и҆ разꙋ́менъ * добродѣ́телми ро́дными, до́блѣ вѣнча́емь: и҆ пребы́лъ є҆сѝ процвѣта́ѧ во ѻ҆бои́хъ, * дꙋше́ю же и҆ тѣ́ломъ; ꙗ҆́коже строи́тель и҆зрѧ́днѣйшій,
И҆зъ оу҆́стъ бг҃ослове́нныхъ, бг҃осло́вна возгремѣ́лъ є҆сѝ оу҆че́нїа, * сѡфро́нїе всебл҃же́нне, бг҃осло́вивъ ꙗ҆́снѣйше ѻ҆ц҃а̀ безнача́лна, и҆ собезна́чална сн҃а, и҆ дх҃а ст҃а́го соприсносꙋ́щна * во є҆ди́ницѣ трⷭ҇цꙋ, и҆ є҆ди́ницꙋ во трⷭ҇цѣ, бг҃а є҆ди́наго со́щественнымъ тождество́мъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пло́ти по ѵ҆поста́си, соедини́вшасѧ безпло́тнаго, * и҆ ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ собезнача́льнаго сло́ва всемꙋ́дре, кромѣ̀ преложенїѧ и҆ слїѧ́нїѧ, мꙋ́дрѣ навꙋчи́лъ є҆сѝ: дѣ́йствꙋюща же сꙋ́гꙋбѡ, ѻ҆бои́ми є҆стествы̀, * и҆зъ ни́хже слїѧ́етъ, и҆ въ ни́хже зри́тсѧ, є҆ди́нъ сы́й нераздѣ́ленъ сꙋщество́мъ, въ се́мъ и҆ ѻ҆́номъ разꙋмѣва́емый.
items.english_cohort_translation: Concerning the flesh, united hypostatically unto the incorporeal and co-unoriginate Word of the Father, O all-wise one, without alteration and without confusion, thou didst wisely teach: acting doubly in both natures, in which He consists and in which He is contemplated, being One, undivided in essence, understood in both the one and the other.[^129]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тꙋ́чами дх҃а прест҃а́гѡ пречта́ѧ, мою̀ мы́сль ѡ҆росѝ, * ꙗ҆́же ка́плю ро́ждшаѧ хрⷭ҇та̀ неизче́тнѡ, безмѣ̑рнаѧ беззакѡ́нїа человѣ́кѡвъ, * щедро́тами и҆змыва́ющꙋю: и҆зсꙋшѝ и҆сто́чникъ страсте́й мои́хъ, * и҆ пото́ка мѧ̀ сподо́би * пи́щи живы́ѧ при́снѡ, мл҃твами твои́ми.
items.english_cohort_translation: With the showers of the All-Holy Spirit, O all-pure one, bedew my mind, thou who didst bear Christ, the Drop that through compassions washes away the immeasurable and countless iniquities of men; dry up the fountain of my passions, and vouchsafe me ever of the torrent of living delight by thy prayers.[^130]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крестобг҃оро́диченъ: подо́бенъ то́йже: На крⷭ҇тѣ́ тѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ оу҆́зрѣ * пригвожде́на гдⷭ҇и, а҆́гница * и҆ мт҃и твоѧ̀ дивлѧ́шесѧ, * что̀ видѣ́нїе сїѐ взыва́ше, сн҃е возжделѣ́нне, сїѧ̑ тѝ непокори́вый собо́ръ воздадѐ беззако́нный, * и҆́же мно́гихъ твои́хъ чꙋде́съ наслади́выйсѧ? * но сла́ва неизглаго́ланномꙋ * соше́ствїю твоемꙋ̀ вл҃ко.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion, the same Podoben (Подо́бенъ то́йже):* When the Ewe-lamb and Thy Mother beheld Thee nailed upon the Cross, O Lord, she marveled, crying out: What is this sight, O longed-for Son? Did the lawless and disobedient synagogue render this unto Thee, having enjoyed Thy many miracles? But glory unto Thine ineffable condescension, O Master!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Цѣломꙋ́дреннѡ преплы́лъ є҆сѝ цѣломꙋ́дрїа пꙋчи́нꙋ, вѣ́тры дх҃о́вными направлѧ́емь. и҆ собра́лъ є҆сѝ мно́го бога́тство, мꙋ́дрости дарова́нїа, ѻ҆́тче сѡфро́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: In chastity didst thou cross the abyss of chaste wisdom, being directed by spiritual winds; and thou didst gather great wealth of gifts of wisdom, O father Sophronius.

items.office: Month of March ...with a Kathisma, as was prescribed for Monday of the 2nd week of the Fast. Likewise also Matins, and the entire service of the Martyrs
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гг҃лъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇това воскрⷭ҇нїа, и҆ предстѣ́датель бж҃е́ственъ бж҃е́ственнагѡ гро́ба, ѡ҆богати́вшагѡ и҆сто́чникомъ безсме́ртїа, хрⷭ҇та̀ воздви́гшагѡ паде́нїе ро́да на́шегѡ.
items.english_cohort_translation: As an angel of Christ's Resurrection wast thou, and a divine hierarch of the divine Tomb that hath enriched [us] with a fountain of immortality, of Christ Who raised up the fall of our race.[^133]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: Month of March ...with a Kathisma, as was prescribed for Monday of the 2nd week of the Fast. Likewise also Matins, and the entire service of the Martyrs
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣ́тлостїю слове́съ твои́хъ, и҆ оу҆ма̀ ѡ҆строто́ю, мі́ръ ѡ҆зари́лъ є҆сѝ, бг҃осло́вивъ ꙗ҆́снѡ, трїѵпоста́снагѡ бж҃тва̀ сꙋщество̀, є҆ди́ницꙋ тричи́сленнꙋю, ѻ҆́тче сѡфро́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: By the radiance of thy words and the sharpness of thy mind thou didst enlighten the world, clearly theologizing concerning the essence of the Tri-hypostatic Godhead, the Trinity in three persons, O father Sophronius.

items.office: Month of March ...with a Kathisma, as was prescribed for Monday of the 2nd week of the Fast. Likewise also Matins, and the entire service of the Martyrs
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Глагѡ́лъ вѣща́нїе твоѐ и҆ оу҆че́нїй бл҃гознамени́таѧ гꙋ́сль, протечѐ земны́ѧ концы̀, та́инствꙋ строе́нїа сло́ва оу҆ча́щаѧ, ѻ҆́тче софро́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: The utterance of thy words and the melodious harp of thy teachings traversed the ends of the earth, teaching the mystery of the dispensation of the Word, O father Sophronius.[^134]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Сы́нъ є҆стество́мъ несозда́ненъ, и҆ ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ соприсносꙋ́щенъ, и҆ време́нъ превы́шшїй, и҆ превѣ́чный, и҆зъ тебѐ вл҃чце зи́ждемь, и҆ подъ лѣ́томъ ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣ́къ быва́етъ, спасѧ́й человѣ́ка.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* The Son, uncreated by nature and co-ever-existing with the Father, above times and pre-eternal, is fashioned from thee, O Sovereign Lady, and comes under time as man, saving man.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, г҃. і҆рмо́съ: Не мꙋ́дростїю, и҆ си́лою, и҆ бога́тствомъ хва́лимсѧ, но тобо́ю ѻ҆́тчею ѵ҆поста́сною мꙋ́дростїю хрⷭ҇тѐ: нѣ́сть бо ст҃ъ, па́че тебѐ человѣколю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Not in wisdom, nor in power, nor in wealth do we boast, but in Thee, the hypostatic Wisdom of the Father, O Christ; for none is holy save Thee, O Lover of mankind.[^135]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆твержда́ема па́лицею слове́съ твои́хъ прпⷭ҇бне, стремле́нїа ѕлочести́выхъ, и҆ собо́рныхъ є҆ресе́й ѡ҆тража́етъ ѿгонѧ́щи це́рковь хрⷭ҇то́ва.
items.english_cohort_translation: Strengthened by the staff of thy words, O venerable one, the Church of Christ repels and drives away the onrushes of the impious and council-gathering heresies.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Поко́рствовавъ по честны̑мъ бг҃оно́се проповѣ́данїи, показа́лсѧ є҆сѝ побѣди́тель помо́щїю дх҃а, мꙋ́дрѣ оу҆крѣплѧ́емь, ѻ҆́тче сѡфро́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having subjected thyself unto the honorable proclamations, O God-bearer, thou wast revealed as a victor by the help of the Spirit, being wisely strengthened, O father Sophronius.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆мертви́въ всѐ тлѣ́емое пло́ти сладостра́стїе, нетлѣ́нною дꙋ́шꙋ бл҃гоче́стїемъ ѡ҆живи́лъ є҆сѝ: и҆ сп҃о пока́залъ є҆сѝ бж҃е́ственный ѻ҆рга́нъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having put to death all corruptible voluptuousness of the flesh, thou didst quicken thy soul with incorruptible piety, and didst reveal thyself as a divine instrument of the Savior.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆бнови́ла є҆сѝ чⷭ҇таѧ бж҃е́ственнымъ ржⷭ҇тво́мъ твои́мъ, и҆стлѣ́вшее во страсте́хъ земноро́дныхъ ме́ртвенное сꙋ́щество, и҆ воздви́гла є҆сѝ всѧ̑ ѿ сме́рти къ живо́тꙋ нетлѣ́нїа: тѣ́мже тѧ̀ по до́лгꙋ блажи́мъ всѝ дв҃о препросла́вленнаѧ, ꙗ҆́коже прорекла̀ є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: By thy divine childbearing, O pure one, thou hast renewed the mortal nature of earthborn men that was corrupted in passions, and hast raised up all from death unto the life of incorruption; therefore, as is due, we all bless thee, O most glorified Virgin, as thou didst foretell.[^137]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крестобг҃оро́диченъ: На крⷭ҇тѣ́ тѧ возвы́шена ꙗ҆́кѡ оу҆зрѣ̀ пречⷭ҇таѧ мт҃и твоѧ̀ сло́ве бж҃їй, ма́терски рыда́ющи вѣща́ше: что̀ но́вое и҆ стра́нное сїѐ чꙋ́до сн҃е мо́й? ка́кѡ жи́знь всѣ́хъ вкꙋша́еши сме́рти? ѡ҆живи́ти оу҆ме́ршыѧ хотѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion:* When Thine all-pure Mother beheld Thee raised upon the Cross, O Word of God, weeping maternally she cried aloud: What is this new and strange wonder, O my Son? How dost Thou, the Life of all, taste of death, willing to quicken the dead as the Compassionate One?[^138]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆мѣ́ѧ цѣломꙋ́дреннꙋ мы́сль, и҆ оу҆́мъ цѣломꙋ́дрѣйшїй, не смѣше́нїе мꙋ́дровалъ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е, ни преложенїе, нижѐ слїѧ́нїе, соединенны́хъ непрело́жнѡ, двои́хъ є҆сте́ствъ во є҆ди́номъ хрⷭ҇тѣ̀ є҆диноро́днемъ, всеблаже́нне.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Просвѣща́емь бж҃твеннымъ просвѣще́нїемъ дх҃а, лю́тое неи́стовство нестѡ́рїево разорна́лъ є҆сѝ, то́южде во́лею и҆ разꙋ́момъ, и҆́же соединенїе препово́давшагѡ хрⷭ҇то́вꙋ ѻ҆бою̀ є҆́тиствꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Enlightened by the divine illumination of the Spirit, thou didst destroy the fierce frenzy of Nestorius by the same will and mind, having proclaimed the union of both natures of Christ.[^141]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆́гглѧ попали́лъ є҆сѝ бгомоу́дре, ѻ҆гне́мъ оу҆че́нїй твои́хъ, ѿмета́ющѧ два̀ бы́ти хрⷭ҇тѡ́ва хотѣ́нїѧ: разли́чными сꙋ́щїи ты̀ ꙗ҆́же по себѣ̀, дѣ́йства же вкꙋ́пѣ сꙋ́гꙋба, ѻ҆́ч҃е преподо́бне.
items.english_cohort_translation: With the fire of thy teachings, O God-wise one, thou didst consume the coals of them that reject that there are two wills of Christ, different in their respective natures, and two operations together, O venerable father.[^142]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, гла́съ, и҃. Подо́бенъ: Взбра́нной: И҆́же бж҃твенною ре́вностїю подви́гсѧ, и҆ и҆́стиннныхъ повелѣ́нїй оу҆стнѣ̑ распросте́ръ: цр҃ко́внаѧ ѡ҆снова́нїа бл҃гозако́ннѡ, и҆ та́мѡ сꙋ́щымъ мона́шескимъ соста́вѡмъ преда́въ, премꙋ́дрый въ патрїа́рсѣхъ і҆ерлми́мскїй сѡфро́нїе, всемꙋ́дра словеса̀ во свѣ́тъ и҆звелъ є҆сѝ, и҆́миже наставля́еми зове́мъ тѝ: ра́дꙋйсѧ свѣ́тлаѧ правосла́вныхъ похвало̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Roused by divine zeal, and opening the lips of true commandments, having canonical-lawfully handed down the foundations of the Church unto the monastic orders there, O all-wise Sophronius, patriarch among the hierarchs of Jerusalem: thou didst bring all-wise words into the light, wherewith guided we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O radiant boast of the Orthodox!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, и҃. і҆рмо́съ: Ѻ҆́троки бл҃гочести̑выѧ въ пещѝ, ржⷭ҇тво̀ бг҃оро́дичо спасло̀ є҆́сть, тогда̀ оу҆́бѡ ѡ҆бразꙋ́емое, ны́нѣ же дѣ́йствꙋемое, вселе́нную всю̀ воздвиза́етъ пѣ́ти тебѣ̀: гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The childbearing of the Birthgiver of God saved the pious youths in the furnace: then indeed prefigured, but now in reality active, it raises up all the universe to sing unto Thee: Praise the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all unto all ages![^151]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆ера́ршескагѡ сщ҃еннодѣ́йства, мѵ́ромъ ѡ҆сти́лсѧ є҆сѝ бл҃года́ти: и҆дѣ́же ꙗ҆ви́сѧ мі́ра спасенїе, а҆рхїере́йствовавъ всемꙋ́дре ѻ҆́ч҃е сѡфро́нїе, зовы́й: гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀, во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: With the myrrh of grace wast thou anointed for the hierarchic sacred ministry, where the salvation of the world was manifested, having served as hierarch, O all-wise father Sophronius, crying: Praise the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all unto all ages![^152]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Премꙋ́дрость почита́ѧ лꙋ́чшꙋю, вѣ́нцемъ бл҃года́тей вѣнча́лсѧ є҆сѝ, сла́вꙋ невѧ́даемꙋ, и҆ бога́тство неѡ́емлемо, премꙋ́дрости сла́вне да́ръ прїе́мъ. и҆ гдⷭ҇а по́йте зовы́й: и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: Honoring transcendent Wisdom, thou wast crowned with a crown of graces, having received unfading glory and inalienable wealth, the gift of wisdom, O glorious one; and crying: Praise the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сщ҃еннолѣ́пнѡ сщ҃еннотаи́нниче, въ бж҃твеннꙋю пра́вдꙋ ѡ҆дѣ́ѧвсѧ: оу҆пра́вилъ є҆сѝ всеблаже́нне ѻ҆́ч҃е, превѣ́ншими ба́чне ста́до, словесы̀ и҆ дѣѧ́нїи. гдⷭ҇а по́йте навꙋча́ѧ: и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ ко всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: In a hieratically comely manner, O sacred initiate, having clothed thyself in divine righteousness, O all-blessed father, thou didst guide the chosen flock with words and deeds, teaching them: Praise the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto all ages![^153]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѻ҆́ч҃е бгомꙋ́дре ѳеофа́не, * бгоꙗ҆вле́нїа хрⷭ҇то́ва, нарече́нъ тезоимени́тъ, * живоно́снымъ стопа́мъ тогѡ̀ послѣ́довалъ є҆сѝ: и҆ кра́снаѧ житїѧ̀ ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ, * взира́ѧ къ жела́емомꙋ тебѣ̀, добро́тою преизрѧ́днѣйше, * и҆ бж҃твенными манове́нїи ꙗ҆́же къ немꙋ̀, и҆зрѧ́дными ѡ҆божа́емь, и҆ коне́чными.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѻ҆́ч҃е бгомо́дре ѳеофа́не, * и҆зна́нїа гѡ́рькаѧ, въ немо́щи пребыва́ѧ, * терпѣли́внѡ претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, не пощадѣ́въ тѣлесѐ за чтна́ѧ і҆кѡ́ны всехва́льне, * ꙗ҆́ростїю львѡ́въ заточа́емь. * и҆́мже рꙋша́ѧ совѣ́ты ѡ҆божи́лъ є҆сѝ * и҆ помышле́нїа сꙋ́щымъ сꙋемꙋ́дренна, и҆ оу҆́мъ пагꙋ́бный.
items.english_cohort_translation: O God-wise father Theophanes, abiding in weakness thou didst endure bitter exiles with longsuffering, not sparing thy body for the sake of the honorable icons, O all-praised one, being exiled by the rage of Leo; whereby, breaking the counsel of the lion, thou didst overturn the thoughts and destructive mind of the vainly-wise.[^160]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пои́стиннѣ воздаѧ́нїа болѣ́зней твои́хъ: * бл҃ги́хъ дѣ́тель бога́тнѡ тебѣ̀ дарова̀: * ѿгонѧ́ти де́моны, * и҆ цѣли́ти недꙋ́ги * пода́въ всеблаже́нне си́лꙋ. * сподо́бивъ тѧ̀ несказа́нныѧ ра́дости, * и҆дѣ́же ликꙋ́ютъ а҆́гглстїи чи́ни, вы́нѡ лицѐ зрѧ́ще * вседержи́телѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: In truth the Worker of good things richly granted thee rewards for thy sufferings: having given thee power, O all-blessed one, to drive away demons and to heal sicknesses; having vouchsafed thee unspeakable joy where the angelic ranks exult, ever beholding the face of the Almighty.[^161]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ра́дꙋйсѧ свѣ́та бж҃е́ственнагѡ носи́ло, свѣтлѣ́йшаѧ ѕвѣздо̀, и҆ сѣ́ни сщ҃е́нїа * свѣ́тъ на́мъ возсїѧ̀, и҆зъ пречⷭ҇тыхъ чре́слъ твои́хъ, * просвѣща́ѧ мі́ра концы̀, и҆ ѡ҆бща́ѧ свое́ю бл҃гтїю; ра́дꙋйсѧ нача́ло спасенїа пречⷭ҇таѧ: ра́дꙋйсѧ оу҆жа́сное слы́шанїе и҆ глаго́ланїе * надѣ́ющымсѧ на тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Month of March* Rejoice, O chariot of the Divine Light, most radiant star and tabernacle of sanctification; for the Light shone forth upon us from thy most pure loins, enlightening the ends of the world and communing with all by His grace; rejoice, O cause of our salvation, all-pure one; rejoice, O terrible hearing and speaking for them that hope in thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крестобг҃оро́диченъ: подо́бенъ то́йже. Что̀ зри́мое видѣ́нїе, * є҆́же мои́ма ѻ҆чи́ма ви́дитсѧ ѻ҆ вл҃ко? * Содержа́й всю̀ тва́рь, * на дре́во воздви́женъ бы́въ и҆ оу҆мира́еши всѣ̑мъ даѧ́й жи́знь: бц҃а пла́чꙋщисѧ глаго́лаше: * є҆гда̀ оу҆зрѣ̀ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ возноси́ма, и҆зъ неѧ̀ неизрече́ннѡ возсїѧ́вшаго * бг҃а и҆ человѣ́ка.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion, the same Podoben (Подо́бенъ то́йже):* What is this visible sight which is seen by mine eyes, O Master? Thou Who holdest all creation art lifted up upon the Tree and tastest death, giving life unto all!—the Birthgiver of God, weeping, spoke, when she beheld God and man, Who ineffably shone forth from her, being lifted up upon the Cross.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мо́рѧ чермнꙋ́ю пꙋчи́нꙋ, невла́жными стопа́ми, дре́внїй пѣшеше́ствовавъ їи҃ль, крестоѡбра́зными мѡѷсе́овыма рꙋка́ма, а҆мали́ковꙋ си́лꙋ въ пꙋсты́ни побѣди́лъ є҆́сть.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having traversed the deep of the Red Sea with dryshod steps, ancient Israel of old, by the crosswise hands of Moses, vanquished the power of Amalek in the wilderness.[^163]

items.office: Month of March ...with a Kathisma, as was prescribed for Monday of the 2nd week of the Fast. Likewise also Matins, and the entire service of the Martyrs
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃а пло́тїю ꙗ҆́вльшагѡсѧ стопа́мъ послѣ́довалъ є҆сѝ, бл҃гоче́стїемъ ѻ҆́ч҃е разже́гсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿсю́дꙋ зва́нїе прїе́мъ, є҆́же пои́стиннѣ тезоиме́нно, ꙗ҆́кѡ промы́шленїемъ прошбразова́сѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst follow the footsteps of God Who appeared in the flesh, being kindled with piety, O father, receiving from thence a name that is truly kindred, as was prefigured by divine providence.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: Month of March ...with a Kathisma, as was prescribed for Monday of the 2nd week of the Fast. Likewise also Matins, and the entire service of the Martyrs
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Наслажда́ѧсѧ желаннѣ́йшымъ раче́нїемъ бл҃гѝ твоегѡ̀, пренебре́глъ є҆сѝ любо́вь мірскꙋ́ю: сраствори́вжесѧ бж҃е́ственнѣй любвѝ, жите́йскꙋю красотꙋ̀ въ ничто́же вмѣни́лъ є҆сѝ всебл҃же́нне.
items.english_cohort_translation: Delighting in the most longed-for desire of thy Good One, thou didst despise worldly love; and having united thyself unto divine love, thou didst account the beauty of this life as nothing, O all-blessed one.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆стреми́всѧ ѕвѣрови́днѡ, гонѧ́ше ле́въ томи́тель и҆збра́нныѧ, не терпѧ̀ зрѣ́ти почита́емꙋ і҆кѡ́нꙋ хрⷭ҇товꙋ: съ ни́миже и҆ тѧ̀ ѳеофа́не, и҆згна́нїю ѡ҆сꙋдѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Rushing forth beast-like, the tyrant Leo persecuted the chosen, unable to endure beholding the icon of Christ honored; with whom he also condemned thee, O Theophanes, unto exile.[^164]

Созда́вый въ нача́лѣхъ ѿ пе́рсти мѧ̀ чл҃вѣка, зи́ждетсѧ менѐ ра́ди во чре́вѣ твое́мъ всенепоро́чнаѧ, дре́внее паде́нїе и҆справлѧ́ѧ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, и҃. Подо́бенъ: Премꙋ́дрости: Рачи́тель любвѐ і҆и҃совы бы́въ, * ѿрази́лъ є҆сѝ сла̑сти, и҆ жите́йскїй мяте́жъ, и҆ мона́шествовавъ пожи́лъ є҆сѝ на землѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ нб҃ный а҆́гглъ, и҆ чꙋде́съ то́чиши дарова́нїа преподо́бне. тѣ́мже бо свѣ́тоноснѣ́й и҆ ст҃ѣ́й твое́й па́мѧти, * вѣ́рнѡ восхваля́емъ тѧ̀, и҆ согла́снѡ вопїе́мъ тѝ: бгоно́се ѳеофа́не; молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, прегрѣше́нїй ѡ҆ставле́нїе дарова́ти, * чтꙋ́щымъ любо́вїю ст҃ꙋ́ю па́мѧть твою̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having become a lover of the love of Jesus, thou didst repel pleasures and worldly confusion; and having lived monastically upon earth like a heavenly angel, thou pourest forth the gifts of wonders, O venerable one. Therefore in thy light-bearing and holy memory we faithfully praise thee, and with one accord cry aloud unto thee: O God-bearer Theophanes, pray unto Christ God to grant remission of transgressions unto them that honor thy holy memory with love.[^168]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ дв҃ꙋ и҆ є҆ди́нꙋ въ жена́хъ тѧ̀ безъ сѣ́мене родшꙋю бг҃а пло́тїю, всѝ оу҆блажа́емъ ро́ди чл҃вѣ́честїи: ѻ҆́гнь бо всели́сѧ въ тѧ̀ бж҃ества̀, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ младе́нца дои́ши зижди́телѧ и҆ гдⷭ҇а. тѣ́мъ а҆́гглскїй и҆ человѣ́ческїй ро́дъ, досто́йнѡ сла́вимъ престо́е ржⷭ҇тво̀ твоѐ; и҆ согла́снѡ вопїе́мъ тѝ: молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, согрѣше́нїй ѡ҆ставле́нїе дарова́ти, покланѧ́ющымсѧ вѣ́рою престо́мꙋ ржⷭ҇твꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: As the Virgin and only one among women who without seed didst bear God in the flesh, all we generations of men call thee blessed; for the fire of the Godhead took up His abode in thee, and like an infant dost thou nurse the Creator and Lord. Therefore, both angelic and human race, we worthily glorify thy most holy childbearing, and with one accord cry aloud unto thee: Pray unto Christ God to grant remission of transgressions unto them that bow down with faith before thy most holy childbearing.[^169]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крестобг҃оро́диченъ: А҆́гнца и҆ па́стырѧ и҆ и҆зба́вителѧ, а҆́гница зрѧ́щи на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ восклица́ше пла́чꙋщи, и҆ го́рькѡ рыда́ющи вопїѧ́ше: мі́ръ оу҆́бѡ ра́дꙋетсѧ прїе́млѧ тобо́ю и҆збавле́нїе. оу҆тро́ба же моѧ̀ гори́тъ зрѧ́щи твоѐ распѧ́тїе, є҆́же те́рпиши за милосе́рдїе ми́лости, долготерпѣли́ве гдⷭ҇и, ми́лости бе́здно, и҆ и҆сто́чниче неисчерпа́емый, оу҆милосе́рдисѧ и҆ да́рꙋй согрѣше́нїй ѡ҆ставле́нїе, вѣ́рою пою́щымъ бж҃ественныѧ стра́сти твоѧ̑.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding the Lamb, and Shepherd, and Redeemer upon the Cross, the Ewe-lamb cried aloud, weeping, and bitterly lamenting cried out: The world indeed rejoices, receiving deliverance through Thee; but my womb burns, beholding Thy Crucifixion which Thou endurest for the mercy of compassion, O longsuffering Lord, Abyss of mercy and inexhaustible Fountain: have compassion, and grant remission of transgressions unto them that hymn Thy divine passions with faith!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆́косъ: Ни́ землѝ ничто́же предпоче́тъ, послѣ́довалъ є҆сѝ ра́дꙋѧсѧ зовꙋ́щемꙋ Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀: и҆ и҆́го є҆гѡ̀ прїѧ́тъ на ра́мо твоѐ ᲂу҆се́рднѡ, поко́й ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ въ дꙋ́ши твое́й. є҆го́же и҆ мнѣ̀ ни́щемꙋ и҆ ᲂу҆ны́ломꙋ низпослѝ, глаго́лющемꙋ и҆ ника́коже соверша́ющемꙋ, но є҆щѐ ᲂу҆пражнѧ́ющемꙋсѧ въ жите́йскихъ веще́хъ, и҆ чꙋдѧ́щемꙋсѧ, ка́кѡ всѣ́хъ и҆збѣжа́лъ є҆сѝ, сожи́тельницы и҆ бога́тства лиши́всѧ?
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:* Preferring nothing upon earth, thou didst joyfully follow Christ Who called thee; and having fervently taken His yoke upon thy shoulders, thou didst find rest in thy soul; which do thou also send down upon me, poor and despondent, who speak and in no wise perform, but am still occupied in worldly matters, and wonder how thou didst escape all things, having been deprived of a companion of life and of wealth.[^180]

items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Stretching forth his hands, Daniel stopped the mouths of the lions in the pit; and the youths, lovers of piety, girded with virtue, quenched the power of the fire, crying aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise the Lord and exalt Him above all unto all ages![^183]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ви́дѧ бл҃же́нне тве́рдость твоегѡ̀ противле́нїѧ, ле́въ мꙋчи́тель, во и҆згна́нїе тѧ̀ ѡ҆сꙋдѝ горча́йшее всеѕло́бный, съ весе́лїемъ же вопїѧ̀, сїѐ претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ: благослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_cohort_translation: Beholding the firmness of thy opposition, O blessed one, the all-wicked tyrant Leo condemned thee unto most bitter exile; and crying aloud with gladness, thou didst endure this: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord![^184]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: На первоѻбра́зное ви́дѧ і҆кѡ́ны че́сть преходѧ́щꙋ, на три́знище поте́клъ є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ страда́лецъ зако́ннѣйшїй. и҆ побѣди́тель показа́всѧ, вѣне́цъ прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, взыва́ѧ: благослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_cohort_translation: Seeing that the honor of the icon passes over unto the Prototype, thou didst run unto the arena as a most lawful contest-bearer; and having been shown forth as victor, thou didst receive the crown, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord![^185]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Премꙋ́дрости твоеѧ̀ стрꙋѝ, * почерпа́емы мы́сленными ѻ҆́блаки, * и҆сточа́ютъ мі́рꙋ и҆сто́чникъ правосла́вїѧ. * И҆з̾ ни́хже сла́дость вѣ́рнїи почерпа́ющїи, * є҆ресе́й и҆злїѧ̑нїѧ, * ꙗ҆́коже ме́рзкихъ ѿвраща́емсѧ во́дъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The streams of thy wisdom, drawn by noetic clouds, pour forth unto the world a fountain of Orthodoxy; drawing sweetness from which, we faithful turn away from the outflow of heresies as from abominable waters.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Твоѐ чтⷭ҇нѣ́йшее тѣ́ло, * во гро́бѣ лежа̀ не растлѣ̀ ѿню́дъ: * но цѣ́ло ѡ҆брѣ́тесѧ всеблаже́нне нїки́форе. * Е҆́же со тща́нїемъ прине́сше, * ра́довахꙋсѧ правосла́вїѧ пито́мцы, * благосла́внѣ тѧ̀ бг҃омꙋ́дре блажа́ще.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thy most honorable body, lying in the tomb, did not see corruption at all, but was found whole, O all-blessed Nicephorus; bringing which with diligence, the foster-children of Orthodoxy rejoiced, gloriously blessing thee, O God-wise one.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Хра́мъ бж҃їй бы́вша тѧ̀ * бж҃е́ственными дѣѧ́ньми * хра́мъ а҆пⷭ҇льскїй зва́нїемъ почте́нный, * прїе́млетъ всебл҃же́нне, * по погребе́нїи сщ҃е́ннѡ погреба́емаго, * и҆ спогре́бша всѧ̑ є҆ретї́ческаѧ ѕлосмра̑днаѧ блѧде́нїѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: A temple of God having become through divine deeds, the temple honored by the apostolic calling receives thee, O all-blessed one, sacredly buried after burial, having buried along with thee all the foul-smelling babblings of heresy.[^189]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прегрѣше́нїй пꙋчи́ною ѡ҆бурева́емь, * къ ти́хомꙋ приста́нищꙋ прибѣго́хъ, * прчⷭ҇тѣй мл҃твѣ твое́й, * бг҃ороди́тельнице, * взыва́ю тѝ: спаси́ мѧ, * крѣ́пкою твое́ю десни́цꙋ просте́рши рабꙋ̀ твое́мꙋ, всенепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Tossed about by the tempest of transgressions, I have fled unto the calm haven of thy most pure prayer, O Birthgiver of God; I cry aloud unto thee: Save me, stretching forth thy strong right hand unto thy servant, O all-immaculate one!

items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion:* When the immaculate Virgin beheld the Lamb lifted up upon the Cross, weeping she cried aloud: O my sweet Child, what is this new and most marvelous sight? How art Thou Who holdest all things in Thy fist, nailed in the flesh upon the Tree?[^190]

items.section: Sessional Hymn, Tone 3:* *Tone 3, Podoben: "Of the divine faith" (Бж҃е́ственныѧ вѣ́ры)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, г҃. Подо́бенъ: Бж҃твенныѧ вѣ́ры: Побѣ́дами вѣнча́лъ є҆сѝ це́рковь, пре́лесть ᲂу҆гна́въ ѕлосла́вїѧ, побѣдоно́сецъ сщ҃енъ бы́въ. и҆ ѡ҆сщ҃и́въ мі́ра концы̀, пренесе́нїемъ ст҃ы́хъ мощі́й твои́хъ. ѻ҆́ч҃е прпⷣбне, хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а молѝ, дарова́ти на́мъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_cohort_translation: With victories thou didst crown the Church, having driven away the delusion of evil doctrine, becoming a sacred trophy-bearer; and having sanctified the ends of the world by the translation of thy holy relics, O venerable father: entreat Christ God to grant us great mercy.[^198]

Подо́бенъ: Бж҃твенныѧ вѣ́ры:
Побѣ́дами вѣнча́лъ є҆сѝ це́рковь, пре́лесть ᲂу҆гна́въ ѕлосла́вїѧ, побѣдоно́сецъ сщ҃енъ бы́въ. и҆ ѡ҆сщ҃и́въ мі́ра концы̀, пренесе́нїемъ ст҃ы́хъ мощі́й твои́хъ. ѻ҆́ч҃е прпⷣбне, хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а молѝ, дарова́ти на́мъ ве́лїю ми́лость.

cohort_provenance.verbatim_source: With victories thou didst crown the Church, having driven away the delusion of evil doctrine, becoming a sacred trophy-bearer; and having sanctified the ends of the world by the translation of thy holy relics, O venerable father: entreat Christ God to grant us great mercy.[^198]
